utmSource.title: UTM Campaigns
utmSource.description: Traffic sources tagged with UTM parameters. Use to measure which campaign or channel drives the most clicks and compare performance across promotion strategies.

socialApp.title: Social App Traffic
socialApp.subtitle: Instagram · TikTok · WhatsApp · others
socialApp.description: Percentage of clicks from in-app browsers of social apps (Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp). Indicates the visitor arrived directly from the feed without opening the device browser.

socialIab.phaseDisclaimer: Social in-app data only available for recent clicks (Phase 1 tracking)

descriptions.hourlyClicks: Click distribution across the 24 hours of the day. Identify the peak hour to schedule posts and campaigns at the moment of highest engagement.
descriptions.dayOfWeek: Click volume by day of the week. Discover which days drive the most traffic and focus your actions during those periods.
descriptions.deviceBreakdown: Share of visits by device type (desktop, mobile, tablet). Use this to guide content design and responsiveness decisions.
descriptions.topCountries: Countries that generated the most clicks on this link. Use to prioritize markets and adapt the language or time zone of campaigns.
descriptions.localTimePatterns: Clicks grouped by the visitor's local hour (based on detected timezone). More accurate than server time for international audiences.
descriptions.weekendVsWeekday: Volume comparison between weekends and weekdays. Shows when your audience is most receptive to content.
descriptions.businessHours: Clicks split between business hours (9am–6pm) and outside them. High volume outside this window suggests entertainment or personal consumption (B2C) content.
descriptions.peakAnalysis: Detailed analysis of the highest-engagement hour and day, with practical timing recommendations for launches and campaigns.
descriptions.temporalTrends: Weekly and monthly click volume trend over time. Identify growth cycles, seasonality, or decline.
descriptions.dailyTimeline: Day-by-day history of clicks and unique visitors. Drag to select a time range and zoom into a specific period.
descriptions.hourDayHeatmap: Click intensity by hour of day × day of week combination. Darker cells = higher concentration — use to find the best time to publish.
descriptions.timezoneDistribution: Where visitors come from by the timezone detected in their browser. Useful for aligning post schedules with specific geographic regions.
descriptions.deviceByPeriod: How desktop, mobile, and tablet distribute across each time period (morning, afternoon, evening, dawn). Adapt content format and visual weight per period.
descriptions.choropleth: World map with click intensity per country. Darker colors = higher volume. Hover to see details or click a country to filter rankings.
descriptions.continentBreakdown: Percentage of clicks per continent. Macro view of geographic reach — see which global regions your link is present in.
descriptions.countryDistribution: Share of top countries in total clicks. Shows which markets concentrate your audience and how much each one represents.
descriptions.retention: Rate of visitors who returned to the link (visited more than once). Above 20% indicates content with high recurring-engagement potential.
descriptions.sessionDepth: Number of clicks per session per visitor. Deeper sessions (more clicks) indicate greater interest and engagement with the content.
descriptions.trafficSources: Traffic origin: direct, organic, social media, email, external referrals, etc. Evaluate which channels bring the most visitors to this link.
descriptions.trafficQuality: Click classification into organic, suspicious, and fraud based on device fingerprint and behavioral patterns. Score 0–100; above 70 is considered healthy.
descriptions.browserBreakdown: Browsers most used by your audience (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, etc.). Helps with compatibility decisions and UI testing priorities.
descriptions.osBreakdown: Operating systems most used (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, etc.). Combined with device data, helps build the technical profile of your audience.
descriptions.languages: Languages detected in visitors' browser settings. Use to plan content internationalization or create localized versions.
descriptions.periodSummary: Click totals grouped by time period (morning, afternoon, evening, dawn). Understand which part of the day drives the most traffic to this link.

chart.title: Audience Analysis

tabDescriptions.devices: Share of visits by device type (desktop, mobile, tablet). Use to decide whether content should prioritize responsive layouts or native app experiences.
tabDescriptions.browsers: Most-used browsers in your audience (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, etc.). Helps with compatibility decisions, polyfills, and UI testing priorities.

retention.title: Recurrence Analysis
retention.description: Rate of visitors who returned to the link more than once. Above 20% indicates content with strong recurring-engagement and loyalty potential.
retention.benchmarkNote: Benchmark based on the average industry rate for shortened links (20% returning visitors).
retention.analysisPrefix: Analysis: Your recurrence rate of {{rate}}% is
retention.analysisExcellent: well above the industry average. Excellent work!
retention.analysisGood: above the industry average. Good performance!
retention.recHigh: Keep creating quality content to maintain high user loyalty.
retention.recLow: Consider implementing strategies like newsletters, push notifications or serialized content to increase visitor return.
retention.visitorDistributionDesc: {{returning}} returning visitors out of {{total}} total unique visitors.
retention.analysisRaw: Your return visitor rate is {{rate}}% ({{returning}} of {{total}} unique visitors). New visitors account for {{newPct}}%.

session.title: Session Depth Analysis
session.description: Session depth indicates how many times the same user clicked the link during a visit. Higher values indicate greater interest.
session.engagementBasis: Based on average session depth and user distribution
session.curveDesc: User distribution by number of clicks per session.
session.analysisText: Your users click {{avg}} times per session on average, with {{power}}% being power users (5+ clicks). Session quality is classified as {{quality}}.
session.recHigh: Excellent engagement! Keep creating quality content to keep users interested.
session.recLow: Consider adding call-to-actions, related links or interactive content to increase engagement.
session.powerUserHighlight: Highlight: You have a solid base of power users ({{percent}}%)! Consider creating premium content or loyalty programs.
session.clickDistributionDesc: Distribution of sessions by number of clicks. Each bar shows how many sessions had exactly that many clicks.
session.analysisRaw: Users click an average of {{avg}} times per session. {{powerCount}} sessions ({{power}}%) are power users with 3 or more clicks.

traffic.title: Traffic Source Analysis
traffic.description: Traffic origin: direct, organic, social media, email, external referrals, etc. Evaluate which channels bring the most visitors and how engaged each one is.

traffic.channelDistributionDesc: Share of clicks by traffic channel (social, search, direct, email, referral). Use to diversify sources and reduce dependency on a single channel.
traffic.engagementByChannelDesc: Average session depth per channel. Channels with greater depth indicate more engaged visitors — focus efforts where the return is highest.

sections.channelsDesc: Aggregated view by channel (social, search, direct…). Compare click share and session depth.
sections.originDesc: Individual sources that drove clicks and how visitors arrived (browser, app, API).

recommendations.highSocialTraffic: High social traffic detected. Consider diversifying with SEO and email marketing.
